lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Regularly spaced high-luminance circular clusters arranged in an approximately orthogonal grid posterior to the branchial region, forming clear vertical columns and horizontal rows.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of higher pixel intensity intersecting with horizontal spot rows to form localized luminance maxima at the intersection nodes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct linear features with a high-contrast vertical gradient (specular highlight on superior edge, shadow on inferior edge) running longitudinally along the upper lateral flank.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Diffused, low-density local maxima of pixel intensity distributed within the boundary of the first dorsal fin's silhouette, appearing less distinct than the lateral spots.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple small, dark elongated silhouettes consistent with Echeneidae appendages attached to the ventral region and trailing the posterior edge of the left pectoral fin.
